_note: Who pays which logistics cost under Meesho's published supplier policy. Values are rendered on Numbers & sources with their source. The engine's sellerFloor() follows these; costToServe() ignores them and charges every logistics cost on every order.

rtoReturnShipping.source: supplier.meesho.com/pricing and supplier.meesho.com/shipping — no return-shipping fee on RTO orders

codFee.source: supplier.meesho.com/pricing — no COD or collection fee for suppliers

customerReturnShipping.source: supplier.meesho.com/shipping — reverse shipping on customer returns is charged to the supplier by weight

forwardOnRto.value: Off — forward fee on delivered orders only
forwardOnRto.label_en: Forward fee also charged on RTO orders
forwardOnRto.label_hi: RTO ऑर्डर पर भी आगे की शिपिंग फ़ीस
forwardOnRto.source: DISPUTED — 2026 seller guides disagree on whether the forward fee is charged when an order is returned to origin. Default: delivered orders only. Switch it on under Advanced to see the other reading.

gstOnFees.label_en: GST on shipping fees (forward and reverse)
gstOnFees.label_hi: शिपिंग फ़ीस पर GST (आगे और वापसी)
gstOnFees.source: ASSUMPTION — 18% from the deck's worked example, applied to both the forward and the reverse fee the seller pays

rateSource.source: Valmo DICE data pack by default; switch to 2026 reported seller rates under Advanced

reported2026Forward.label_hi: 2026 की बताई गई आगे की दर, ≤ 500 ग्राम
reported2026Forward.source: ASSUMPTION — third-party 2026 seller guides. Heavier slabs add the same +₹15 to the DICE rate.

reported2026Reverse.label_hi: 2026 की बताई गई वापसी दर, ≤ 500 ग्राम
reported2026Reverse.source: ASSUMPTION — third-party 2026 seller guides. Heavier slabs add the same +₹35 to the DICE rate.
